notes: Evidence contains only independently generated test UI, MCP results and foreground/pointer metadata, not proprietary app code, credentials or raw reverse engineering artifacts.
The final default harness never activates windows or emits global input. Interactive tests remain opt-in and intentionally take foreground control during setup.
Prior passing concurrency and failed notification/stacking experiments are retained together. Historical reports are not silently rewritten as passes.
